header.running_head: The Lecture he Delivered after the Demise of his Father

blocks.text:
I refer to my grandfather Rasulullaah ﷺ as my father.)"
After then reciting some portions of the Qur'aan, he said, "I am the son of the giver of glad tidings, I am the son of the warner, I am the son of Nabi ﷺ, I am the son of the one who called to Allaah with His permission, I am the son of the brilliant lamp and I am the son of the one who was sent as a mercy to the universe. I belong to that household which Allaah had rid of (all spiritual) filth and had thoroughly purified. I belong to that family whom Allaah has made it compulsory (for others) to love and to assist. Allaah says in the revelation He has sent to Muhammad ﷺ:

blocks.arabic_text: قُلْ لَّآ اَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ اَجْرًا اِلَّا الْمَوَدَّةَ فِى الْقُرْبٰى ؕ
blocks.text: 'Say (to the people, O Muhammad ﷺ), 'I ask of you no repayment (for conveying to you the message of Towheed), except (all that I ask for is) the (usual and traditional) love between relatives (that you ought to show to me regardless of what message I carry to you).' [^1]

Another narration adds that Hadhrat Hasan (RA) also said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ would hand over the flag to him (Hadhrat Ali (RA)) and when the battle grew furious, Hadhrat Jibra'eel (AS) would be there to fight by his side." The narrator of this report states that it was the twenty first of Ramadhaan (when Hadhrat Ali (RA) passed away). [^2]

Yet another narration similar to the one of Hadhrat Abu Tufayl adds that Hadhrat Hasan (RA) said, "I am from that family to whom Hadhrat Jibra'eel (AS) descended and with whom he ascended." The narration also states that Hadhrat Hasan (RA) added the concluding part of the above verse when he recited:

blocks.arabic_text: وَمَنْ يَّقْتَرِفْ حَسَنَةً نَّزِدْ لَهٗ فِيْهَا حُسْنًا ؕ
blocks.text: As for the one who carries out a good deed, We will increase the beauty of the deed (by granting a reward for it that is far superior to the deed itself) "
He then explained carrying out a good deed in the this verse refers to imbibing love for the family of Rasulullaah ﷺ. [^3]

Hadhrat Abu Jameela narrates that after Hadhrat Ali (RA) was assassinated, (his son) Hadhrat Hasan (RA) became the Khalifah. However, when he was once leading the salaah, someone leapt at him and stabbed him with a dagger in his buttock. This confined him to bed for a month, after which he stood up to address the people from the pulpit. He said, "O people of Iraq! Fear Allaah when it concerns us because we are both your leaders and your guests. We also belong to the household concerning whom Allaah says:
